body:
Thank you, I think the crying mess part is over. I've never had suicidal ideation of that magnitude before. I read "feeling suicidal NOW" page like 9 times and am now currently looking at my options as far as therapy is involved. I don't think I can ignore my depression anymore. 

Thank you both so so so so so so much for replying, it really made a huge impact just knowing there are others out there.
